messages:
jamie: quick question — we have a Sparklytics contractor that needs to debug OTEL traces/metrics in Honeycomb for a short spike. Can we give them access? main concerns: PII in spans, sampling configuration, and scoping the api key. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGOBS-3241 :thinking_face:

alex: short answer: yes, but must be scoped and temporary. plan i'd use: 1) create a new dataset (sparklytics-debug-2026) 2) generate a dataset-scoped api key with only write/read for that dataset 3) apply server-side attribute scrubbing + dynamic sampling on ingest 4) issue key via Vault with TTL (12h).

jamie: thanks. do you have examples of the scrubbing + sampling config we should push to the OTEL collector?

alex: yep — example OTEL processor snippet we use for masking:
```
processors:
  attributes/mask_user:
    actions:
      - key: user.email
        action: delete
      - key: user.id
        action: hash
      - key: ip
        action: delete
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      processors: [mask_user, batch]
```
and for Honeycomb sampling rule (server-side): set sample rate to 1% for non-error traces and 100% for error spans. In Honeycomb UI it's under Dataset -> Sampling Rules.

maria: please don't forget data retention & third-party forwarding checks. For this contractor we need: - dataset scoped key - no export to third-party integrations - retention set to 7 days for that dataset - add entry to vendor access tracker (security sheet) - approval from CISO if they request anything beyond read-only. Also require a redaction proof artifact: screenshot of masked attributes + small sanitized sample bundle.

sam: infra notes: we'll provision the key in Vault at path secret/apps/sparklytics/debug/<uuid> with TTL 12h. AppRole can be used by the contractor's session host. If they need CLI access, give them a short-lived token via dev workstation jumpbox only. Avoid adding them to any org-level Honeycomb roles.

jamie: got it. i'll create the dataset and set retention to 7d. will configure server-side sampling as alex suggested and push the OTEL processor. will upload redaction proof to ENGOBS-3241.

infra-bot: new secret created at secret/apps/sparklytics/debug/6f4a — expires in 12h (created by sam) :white_check_mark:

maria: once jamie uploads the proof, post the link here and i'll sign off. also add their contractor SOW + minimal access justification in the ticket.

jamie: will do. tagging @maria for final signoff when done. thanks all :thumbsup:
